points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake source is complete and final eight output directories plus report pass structural validation; clean rebuild not repeated because the migrated external symlink is historical/broken.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Source implements documented solve CLI and argument validation; no new executable invocation.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Clear separated mesh, partition, halo, physics, solver, output, and report tooling modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal wrapper/executable or copied-core evidence was found. Trust policy forbids external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case reader and CGNS path input; no case-filename-only branch identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS partitioning, neighbor isend/irecv halo exchange, and MPI reductions are implemented; rank-count evidence is absent.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: All final outputs validate and the report honestly notes no Re200 vortex street, but M0.8 inviscid has appreciable inner target misses.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Complete submitted result set and session-side validation claim agree with evaluator structural validation.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modular C++ and report tooling; legacy absolute paths remain in uncommitted manifests only.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
